output.text: {"notes":["The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; forward_position and forward_velocity are therefore world-frame forward-channel quantities in m and m/s.","The requested readout time is the absolute simulation time t=2.0 s from initialization.","The scheduled intervention begins at t=0.4106 s and remains active through t=2.0 s; it applies zero-target-velocity braking to each axle with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m.","stopped_by_T is true only if absolute forward speed is below 0.02 m/s and planar speed is below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
